game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Mystic Forest – Mushroom Market, a forest mushroom market: the fairy gardener must handle giant beetles while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Loop Choreography: Repeat dance moves in loops to sync a routine with the beat.
theme: Mystic Forest – Mushroom Market: a forest mushroom market
core_gameplay_loop: In Mushroom Market, repeat each round: Repeat dance moves in loops to sync a routine with the beat. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the sync value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the waterfall gate using at most 19 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The waterfall gate reached with actions_used <= 19.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 19 before the waterfall gate is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 10 (extended tier): Loop Choreography
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Loop Choreography' (Week 5 slot 14), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Mushroom Market'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mystic Forest
region.mood: airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how sync changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against giant beetles in Mushroom Market.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The waterfall gate reached with actions_used <= 19.
